caption: Kavala Fortress, Kavala
composition: Castle walls above the Imaret domes · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the harbor, the medieval fortress walls crown the Panagia peninsula, with old houses packed on the slope below. The Imaret's row of low gray domes runs along the water at the foot of the hill. Cloud cover is about 49%, about 14.3°C. The sun is still below the horizon. The castle is not floodlit.
